curated-gf-lumanosimo-gf-wittgenstein: Lumanosimo writes like a quick, friendly hand, every stroke as thick as a drawn wire, perfect for a scrapbook page, say. And Wittgenstein's classic serif body swings between heavy stems and hairline arms, so give it a modest size.
curated-gf-lumanosimo-space-grotesk: Casual pen-and-paper lettering, wire-thick throughout, could headline a band tour t-shirt, say. Space Grotesk's sans body then lays down hollow, breathing counters and ribbon-like lines, which gives the loose handwriting a firm, geometric floor to stand on.
curated-gf-luxurious-script-gf-barlow: Barlow draws its c shapes with the tips pulled well apart. Luxurious Script is best at low, snug, hand-drawn lettering that flows together, while Barlow's sans-serif body is best at staying approachable and constant in stroke.
curated-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-gf-kosugi: Loose, open curves, one steady pen. Kosugi's sans-serif body, with its pliers-jawed c and wire-bent outlines, keeps a longer passage tidy and clean, while LXGW WenKai TC saves the handwriting for the heading.
curated-gf-ma-shan-zheng-fs-bespoke-seri: Bespoke Serif reads dignified and authoritative, thin strokes about half the weight of thick. Ma Shan Zheng crams its handwritten letters together like teeth, a kids cooking class flyer, for instance, so the serif below gives them a steadier, moderate-contrast footing.
curated-gf-macondo-swash-caps-gf-kotta-o: Macondo Swash Caps lifts its capitals well above the lowercase, with the insides of its c clearly visible. Kotta One answers in a squat text serif, its brushy single-width strokes staying low under tall ascenders.
curated-gf-maname-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads modern and clean, with wide openings on small letters (handy for dyslexia friendly materials). Over a long stretch its big lowercase bodies dominate each line while the ascenders barely show, so Maname's literary serif heading stands taller by comparison.
curated-gf-mansalva-newsreader: Newsreader reads authoritative and refined, its curves opening wide with only a restrained gap between stem and hairline. Mansalva sits beside it in relaxed handwriting whose lowercase shrinks beneath the caps, so the two feel like a handwritten note tucked into a printed page.
curated-gf-manufacturing-consent-gf-enri: Enriqueta reads literary and dignified, its chalk curves stopping well before they close. Over a longer passage that openness keeps the lines light, a sharp turn from the huddled, nearly sealed letters of Manufacturing Consent above.
curated-gf-marck-script-gf-wittgenstein: Personal and graceful, Marck Script is at its best as a tight cluster of felt-tip strokes with no thick and thin at all. Wittgenstein's serif is best at drama in miniature, heavy stems carrying hair-thin arms and big entrances into each curve.
